note: EDIT names for your real drivers. Required means needed for the initial sensor/command dataset, not proof of readiness. Optional missing topics stay unavailable. No automatic actuation.

topics.name: /imu/data
topics.purpose: Raw acceleration, gyro, orientation/covariance, source stamp and sensor frame

topics.name: /joint_states
topics.purpose: Named wheel position/velocity and reported effort if actually supplied

topics.name: /scan
topics.purpose: Complete horizontal LiDAR ranges, geometry and per-beam timing

topics.name: /odom
topics.purpose: Estimator pose/twist/covariance; not independent slip ground truth

topics.name: /tf
topics.purpose: Dynamic frame tree and ownership

topics.name: /tf_static
topics.purpose: Declared IMU/LiDAR/base/wheel mounting transforms

topics.name: /cmd_vel
topics.purpose: Final velocity command visible on ROS, not necessarily executed wheel target

topics.name: /cmd_vel_nav
topics.purpose: Navigation source command if stack uses this topic

topics.name: /cmd_vel_teleop
topics.purpose: Teleoperation source command if stack uses this topic

topics.name: /cmd_vel_selected
topics.purpose: Command arbitration output

topics.name: /cmd_vel_smoothed
topics.purpose: Velocity smoother output before collision monitor

topics.name: /nino_drive/diagnostics
topics.purpose: PI target/feedback, requested/limited torque, saturation, integrator when real backend provides these fields

topics.name: /wheel_effort_controller/commands
topics.purpose: Torque COMMAND only if real robot uses this interface; never launch a simulation controller to populate it

topics.name: /wheel_torque_applied
topics.purpose: Limited/applied torque COMMAND if published, not measured torque

topics.name: /battery_state
topics.purpose: Reported supply voltage/current/temperature/charge if instrumented

topics.name: /diagnostics
topics.purpose: Driver faults, motor/thermal/power and communication diagnostics

topics.name: /nino/emergency_stop
topics.purpose: Observed software stop requests; not proof of a physical stop

topics.name: /collision_monitor_state
topics.purpose: Collision monitor intervention state if published

topics.name: /amcl_pose
topics.purpose: Localization estimate/covariance during mapped navigation

topics.name: /plan
topics.purpose: Global reference path if navigation publishes it

topics.name: /map
topics.purpose: Real occupancy map context if mapping or navigation is active

topics.name: /motor_fb
topics.purpose: Original firmware wheel feedback before bridge; reported values require matching fresh status, names and clock verification

topics.name: /motor_status
topics.purpose: Firmware raw status bitmask; decode only against the flashed firmware version

topics.name: /imu/debug
topics.purpose: Firmware IMU diagnostics; not an estimator input

topics.name: /imu/bridge
topics.purpose: Bridge IMU output; header may have been sanitized

topics.name: /odom/unfiltered
topics.purpose: Bridge encoder odometry; not independent body ground truth

topics.name: /scan_raw
topics.purpose: LiDAR input before optional scan deskew

topics.name: /motor_enable
topics.purpose: Observed firmware enable requests; recording does not publish or disable motors

topics.name: /cmd_mit
topics.purpose: Observed MIT command; never replay on connected motors

topics.name: /cmd_torque
topics.purpose: Observed torque command, not measured torque

claim_scope: Full sensor/command dataset with original STM32 channels. Software completeness does not validate motor freshness, mode, safety, slip or timing.
